the calcium pump PMCA2 controls calcium dynamics by α7-nAchRs in interneurons via a scaffold protein, PSD-95.

the role of calcium in the brain and how this role is regulated.
the mechanisms by which calcium concentration is regulated in neurons.
understanding the mechanisms that regulate the function of α7-containing nicotinic acetycholine receptors (α7-nACRs) on aspiny interneurons in the brain.
